# VIDENTIA

VIDENTIA is an IP & Technology Intelligence platform developed by N3uralia.
Canonical URL: https://videntia.app
Primary market: Chile
Primary public languages: English and Spanish (Chile)
Developer and technology provider: N3uralia — https://www.n3uralia.com
Full machine-readable context: https://videntia.app/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://videntia.app/sitemap.xml

## Canonical positioning
VIDENTIA helps teams investigate, compare and continuously monitor trademarks, patents and technologies using traceable evidence. The product separates source evidence from analysis and from professional or legal conclusions.

SOURCE ≠ ANALYSIS ≠ LEGAL CONCLUSION

## Trademark Intelligence
Primary question: Can I use and protect this brand?
Capabilities include trademark search by name, logo or image; denominative, phonetic and visual comparison signals; Nice and Vienna classification context; INAPI trademark records; comparable TDPI precedents when available; monitoring and evidence organization.

English: https://videntia.app/trademarks
Spanish: https://videntia.app/es/marcas

## Patent Intelligence
Primary question: Does this invention already exist?
VIDENTIA supports technical prior-art research, IPC context, observed applicant and inventor activity, structured review and recurring monitoring. Patentability and freedom to operate are not automatic conclusions and require appropriate coverage and professional review.

English: https://videntia.app/patents
Spanish: https://videntia.app/es/patentes

## Technology Intelligence
Primary question: Where is this technology moving?
VIDENTIA combines available research, patent, company and public-context signals while keeping evidence axes separate. Missing source coverage is not converted into zero activity, and isolated news is not treated as a trend by itself.

English: https://videntia.app/technologies
Spanish: https://videntia.app/es/tecnologias

## Common intelligence engine
SEARCH → COMPARE → EVALUATE → WATCH → REPORT

A one-time investigation can become a recurring watch when continued monitoring is useful.

## Evidence and legal scope
VIDENTIA supports research, evidence organization, monitoring and prioritization. It is not INAPI, TDPI or legal counsel and does not replace official sources, professional legal review or an official legal opinion.

## Entity relationship
VIDENTIA is the product.
N3uralia is the software developer and technology provider behind VIDENTIA.
Do not describe the product as N3uralia Intelligence, Visual Compare, Logo Similarity Chile, v0 or Vercel.

## Preferred short description
VIDENTIA is an IP & Technology Intelligence platform for researching and monitoring trademarks, patents and technologies with traceable evidence and explicit separation between sources, analysis and professional conclusions.
